fields.name: levelName
fields.tooltip: Shown on the Mission Complete panel when no city level preceded this run.

fields.name: nextSceneName
fields.tooltip: Scene the panel's NEXT MISSION loads (through the loading curtain).

fields.name: trackLengthMeters
fields.tooltip: Length of this run's track, metres: the three end ramps stand at about this distance (the generator lands the last knot as close as its segments allow). 0 = GameSettings.trackLengthMeters.

fields.name: track
fields.tooltip: A saved track (made in the TrackGenerator's inspector: Generate Track, Save Track As…, Set as Current Track). Set = this level plays exactly that track — its length, its countdown when it sets one, every ramp, orb and gate. Empty = a track is generated for every run (the length above).

fields.name: traffic
fields.tooltip: Oncoming traffic for this level: hover cars driving the track toward the ship (OncomingTrafficPRD.md). Empty = none.

fields.name: race
fields.tooltip: A race: rival hover ships on a grid with the ship, racing it to the end ramps (RaceModePRD.md). Empty = no race. A race level should author no Reach Speed objective and no traffic.

fields.name: timeTrial
fields.tooltip: A time trial: Beat the Clock (a set time to the end ramps) or Arcade (a short clock fed by checkpoints, clean flying and patrol kills) — TimeTrialPRD.md. Empty = none. A time trial level should author a Finish With Time objective and no Reach Speed. Ignored on a race level.

fields.name: trackReveal
fields.tooltip: The track reveal: the road ahead, its placements and the oncoming cars assemble themselves as the ship (or a race's leader) nears them (TrackReveal_Settings tunes it). Off = the whole track stands built, as before.

fields.name: completeVideo
fields.tooltip: Clip looping in the panel's video holder. Empty = the holder shows a dead NO SIGNAL screen.

fields.name: rankTable
fields.tooltip: Rank thresholds for a run played on its own. A run that follows a city level ranks against THAT level's table, carried over by the save.

fields.name: optionalChallenges
fields.tooltip: Live from launch, no accept step. Only COMPLETED ones multiply the mission payout.

fields.name: objectives
fields.tooltip: ALL of these must be met to win the run. Each pays its reward on the Mission Complete panel.

fields.name: sThreshold
fields.tooltip: Mission total at or above this earns an S.

fields.name: aThreshold
fields.tooltip: Mission total at or above this earns an A.

fields.name: bThreshold
fields.tooltip: Mission total at or above this earns a B.

fields.name: cThreshold
fields.tooltip: Mission total at or above this earns a C; anything below is a D.

fields.name: targetSpeedKmh
fields.tooltip: Speed the ship must reach. The first MANDATORY Reach Speed objective is the run's Light Speed — the HUD goal and the speed-lines reference.

fields.name: jumpCount
fields.tooltip: How many ramps the ship must take off from during the run.

fields.name: raceMode
fields.tooltip: Win = finish 1st. Top X = finish X-th or better. Exactly = finish X-th, no better and no worse. Judged as the ship leaves by an end ramp; the run fails early the moment it can no longer be met.

fields.name: racePosition
fields.tooltip: The place X the mode asks for.

fields.name: minSecondsLeft
fields.tooltip: Leave the track by an end ramp with at least this many seconds still on the clock. 0 = just finish before it runs out — a time trial's goal (TimeTrialPRD D3).

fields.name: reward
fields.tooltip: Money this objective pays on the Mission Complete panel, added to the city level's rewards before the challenge multipliers apply.

fields.name: accent
fields.tooltip: HUD tint and panel accent for this goal. Fully transparent = the type's default color.

fields.name: multiplier
fields.tooltip: Reward multiplier for COMPLETING this challenge — the panel shows it as ×N. An unfinished challenge earns nothing.
